# Arrays

Helpers for arrays declared with `Array:` or `Arrays:`. The array is passed by name as the first argument; index ranges are inclusive.

[Back to the keyword reference index](README.md)

### array_compare

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | at least 5 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Compares a run of elements of two arrays: source array, source start, target array, target start, count. Returns 0 when equal, 1 when the first difference is larger in the source and -1 when smaller.

### array_contains

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | bool | at least 2 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

True when the value appears anywhere in the array.

### array_copy

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | at least 5 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Copies a run of elements from one array into another (or within one array): source, source start, target, target start, count. Elements that would fall outside either array are skipped.

```easylanguage
Array: A[4](1), B[4](0);
Array_Copy(A, 0, B, 0, 5);
```

### array_sort

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | at least 4 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Sorts the elements between two indexes in place: ascending when the last argument is true, descending when false.

```easylanguage
Array: A[4](0);
A[0] = 3; A[1] = 1; A[2] = 4;
Array_Sort(A, 0, 4, true);
```

### ArraySize

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | PowerBridge test (`tests/test_release_020_regressions.py`) | no | transpiles; the run stops (not implemented in the runtime) |

Array size query. PowerBridge's runtime does not implement it; use `Array_GetMaxIndex` instead. A run that reaches it stops with an error.
